items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: I think that must be Jim Mewkes.

ctx.x: I don't remember him. I think he died before I... Well, he and the hog were buddies, isn't it? Sure enough. The Black Benny is supposed to have been a great face drum, but I never heard him. I haven't either. I heard a lot of talk of him that he was. The Jimbo was my ideal. Brass. Brass band. What did he look like? I think I knew him. Little short fella, smiling all the time. Always smiling. And he had a beat and had a skip. And he beat that bass drum. He beat it.
And I think I heard him. I think that must be Jim Mewkes. He must be. He really has to be. He's dark, huh? Jimbo? Yeah. He's dark. Yeah, I know.
I don't hear no other drum beating a drum like that. No, I haven't heard it since.
